examples.text: 이 자식 완전 건방지네! 넌 지금 나랑 급이 달라. 어디서 메인만이 짊어질 수 있는 시청률의 무게를 나눠 지려고 하고 있어?
examples.trans: Look how presumptuous this kid is! You are nowhere near my rank—how dare you try to share the weight of ratings that only a lead producer carries?
The mood on set today is truly presumptuous, cheeky.
Do you have time today?
Where are you going?

meanings.note: Used only with close friends, younger people, or children

examples.trans: What time is it now?
I'll leave right now.

examples.text: 이 자식 완전 건방지네! 넌 지금 나랑 급이 달라. 어디서 메인만이 짊어질 수 있는 시청률의 무게를 나눠 지려고 하고 있어?
examples.trans: Look how presumptuous this kid is! You are nowhere near my rank—how dare you try to share the weight of ratings that only a lead producer carries?
The topic of rank, league came up in today's meeting.

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun for location.

examples.trans: Where is the restroom?
Where are you right now?

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'main', used before nouns like 피디 ('PD') or 요리 ('dish').

examples.trans: Today's main dish is steak.
That person is the main writer of this program.

examples.text: 이 자식 완전 건방지네! 넌 지금 나랑 급이 달라. 어디서 메인만이 짊어질 수 있는 시청률의 무게를 나눠 지려고 하고 있어?
examples.trans: Look how presumptuous this kid is! You are nowhere near my rank—how dare you try to share the weight of ratings that only a lead producer carries?

examples.text: 이번에는 꼭 제대로 해 보고 싶어요, 짊어지다는 마음으로요.
examples.trans: This time I really want to do it right (shoulder, bear).

examples.text: 이 자식 완전 건방지네! 넌 지금 나랑 급이 달라. 어디서 메인만이 짊어질 수 있는 시청률의 무게를 나눠 지려고 하고 있어?
examples.trans: Look how presumptuous this kid is! You are nowhere near my rank—how dare you try to share the weight of ratings that only a lead producer carries?
The topic of weight, burden came up in today's meeting.

examples.text: 백승찬, 나 좀 보자. 애들이랑 무슨 얘기 나눴니?
examples.trans: Baek Seung-chan, come see me. What were you talking about with your peers?

examples.text: 이번 일은 꼭 잘 해결해 봐요, 나누다는 마음으로요.
examples.trans: Let's make sure we handle this well (did you share).

examples.text: 저 가위 낼게요. 안 내면 진 거, 가위바위보!
examples.trans: I am going to throw scissors. Lose if you don't throw—rock, paper, scissors!

examples.text: 가위바위보 해서 져서 내가 하루 종일 들고 다니는 걸로 찍혔잖아요.
examples.trans: I lost rock-paper-scissors and was already filmed carrying them all day.

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold
meanings.note: Core verb; also combines with nouns to form verbs.

examples.trans: What are you doing right now?
We are holding a meeting today.

meanings.note: Used as conjunction (그렇지만).

examples.text: 역시 우리 신디는 똑똑해. 그렇지만 신디야, 난 잃어봤단다.
examples.trans: Smart as ever, our Cindy—except Cindy, I have already lost a star like you once before.

examples.text: 너처럼 나한텐 소중한 아이였어. 그렇지만 그 아이를 잃고 나니까 네가 왔잖니?
examples.trans: She was just as precious to me as you are—yet right after I lost her, you came along, remember?

meanings.note: Hangul spelling of the English abbreviation PD, widely used in Korean broadcasting.

examples.trans: Who is the PD in charge of the new program?

examples.text: 그녀는 예능 피디가 되기 위해 시험을 준비했다.
examples.trans: She prepared for the exam to become a variety PD.

meanings.note: Everyday spoken contraction of 이것.

examples.trans: How much is this?
Please look at this.

examples.text: 이건 메인만의 특권이야! 잘 나왔을 때의 영광도 안 나왔을 때의 치욕과 굴욕도 메인만이 가질 수 있는 거라고. 어디서 내 굴욕을 가져가려고 그래!
examples.trans: This is the lead producer's exclusive privilege! Both the glory of a hit and the humiliation of a flop belong solely to the lead—do not try stealing my humiliation!
The topic of is the exclusive privilege came up in today's meeting.
Listen closely to what I explain.
I eat Korean food well.

meanings.en: to appear, be published, be achieved (a score/result)
meanings.note: Used for ratings, test scores, or results coming out

examples.trans: I came outside from the house.
The exam results came out well.

meanings.note: Often used as a bound noun after -(으)ㄹ to mean 'when' or 'while'.

examples.trans: Call me when you have time.
I lived in this neighborhood when I was young.

examples.text: 이건 메인만의 특권이야! 잘 나왔을 때의 영광도 안 나왔을 때의 치욕과 굴욕도 메인만이 가질 수 있는 거라고. 어디서 내 굴욕을 가져가려고 그래!
examples.trans: This is the lead producer's exclusive privilege! Both the glory of a hit and the humiliation of a flop belong solely to the lead—do not try stealing my humiliation!
The topic of glory too came up in today's meeting.

examples.text: 이건 메인만의 특권이야! 잘 나왔을 때의 영광도 안 나왔을 때의 치욕과 굴욕도 메인만이 가질 수 있는 거라고. 어디서 내 굴욕을 가져가려고 그래!
examples.trans: This is the lead producer's exclusive privilege! Both the glory of a hit and the humiliation of a flop belong solely to the lead—do not try stealing my humiliation!
The topic of disgrace and came up in today's meeting.

examples.text: 티브이도 잘 안 보시는구나. 오늘 여러모로 굴욕을 많이 당하네요.
examples.trans: You don't watch television much either. I am suffering humiliation in many ways today.
The topic of humiliation came up during this shoot.

meanings.en: to have, to possess, to take
meanings.note: Often shortened to 갖다.

examples.trans: I have an interest.
Please bring it (take it and come).
This is my bag.
My younger sibling is a student.

meanings.note: Contraction of 나 (I) + 의 (possessive)
Used as promissive polite (가져갈게요.).

examples.text: 이거 유출되면 안 되니까 일단 내가 가져갈게요.
examples.trans: Since this photo must never leak out, I will take the memory card with me for now.
Let us do that (will take it along) right away.

그렇다.gloss: to be so, to do so

meanings.en: to be like that, to be so
meanings.note: ㅎ-irregular; also used as a pro-verb ('do so / say so')

examples.trans: Is that really so?
Don't keep acting like that.

meanings.note: Used when repeating an action.

examples.trans: See you again!
It is raining again.

meanings.note: Action of coming together with someone.

examples.trans: I meet a friend.
Let's meet tomorrow.
